_comment: Seed for tools/learn-routes.js until Yapton has a definition (crossing-launch Stage 5). Not loaded by the backend (a dotted file name is not a definition). The clear steps come from the barrier: node tools/learn-routes.js yapton <from> <to> --find-clear. Direction slots: up = eastbound (Barnham -> Ford, towards Brighton), down = westbound.
